title: Coupled quintessence from an axion dark sector
summary: Recent observational data arising from the DESI collaboration has hinted at a possible departure from the standard $Λ$CDM cosmological model, preferring instead the presence of a dynamical dark energy component. Specifically, the associated equation of state of the dark energy features a crossing into the so-called phantom regime, which is challenging to accommodate in canonical single scalar-field scenarios.
